title: 第一卷 正文第5章 赤火果第一卷 正文第6章 灵者八重天
content_zh:
想要最大程度吸收药材的药效，最好的方法便是将其炼制成丹药。所以，楚凌天打算成为炼丹师。
虽然《炼丹师基础》只是入门手册，但修炼难度极大。但好在，楚凌天拥有混沌宝塔，最不缺的就是时间。
将东西收入宝塔第一层空间后，楚凌天便离开交易坊市，以最快的速度出城，进入城外的风云山脉。
风云山脉，乃是一座妖兽山脉。山脉中，灵气浓郁，栖息着不少妖兽。其中甚至有强大的二阶高级妖兽。
妖兽和修士一样，同样有着强弱之分。
九州大陆，将妖兽分为九大境界。由低到高，分别是一阶妖兽、二阶妖兽、三阶妖兽……九阶妖兽。
每阶妖兽又细分为低级、中级、高级，三个级别。
一阶低级妖兽，实力相当于灵士一重天到三重天的修士。一阶中级妖兽，实力相当于灵士四重天到六重天的修士，以此类推……
而二阶高级妖兽，实力则相当于灵师七重天到九重天的强者。
风云城便是因为靠近风云山脉，所以才得名风云城。
楚凌天之所以离开楚家，进入风云山脉。一是因为收拾了楚云后，楚山必定会猜到他已经可以重新修炼，会对他暗下杀手。
二是因为，风云山脉天地灵气浓郁，除了栖息着不少妖兽外，还生长着许多珍贵的药材。
楚凌天并不需要找到成熟的一品药材，只要找到一品药材的种子，或者未成熟的一品药材，将它们种入宝塔第一层空间即可。
这样一来，寻找药材的难度，将大大降低。
正如楚凌天预料的那样，就在他刚刚进入风云山脉之时，家主楚山便带着数名长老，气势汹汹地来到楚凌天的别院。
“楚凌天，你无故行凶、重伤族人，还不滚出来领罪！”楚山寒声道。
楚云的父亲，三长老楚江直接冲入屋内，欲要杀了楚凌天，替楚云报仇，却发现楚凌天根本不在屋内。
“楚凌天跑了！”楚江恨意滔天地说道。
楚山闻言，眼中寒光一闪，立刻命令楚家族人，全城搜捕楚凌天。
一个时辰后，带队搜捕的长老返回楚家汇报。

“家主，根据线索，楚凌天已经进入了风云山脉。”楚山闻言，眼睛微微一眯，心中涌起一股不安。
“当初就应该一不二、二不休，直接在抽离灵炎血脉之时，将楚凌天弄死。虽然会背负骂名，但也比埋下祸根强。”楚山心中悔恨道。
看到楚山脸上的担忧，楚浩辰开口道：“父亲不用担心，只要楚凌天想要进入学宫，八天后必定会现身，与我进行生死对决。那时，我将亲手将其格杀。”
按照楚云的描述，楚凌天受损的根基即便恢复了，修为只有灵者六重天而已。
而他的修为，可是达到了灵者九重天。足足比楚凌天高了三个小境界。
而且，更重要的是，楚山在将灵炎血脉献给主家之时，主家赐下了大量的奖赏。
其中，便有精进修为的丹药“灵武丹”。
灵武丹乃是二品中阶丹药，药效比蕴气丹强大数倍！
在灵武丹的辅助下，楚浩辰自信能在半个月内，突破至灵师一重天，甚至更高！
content_en:
If you want to maximize the effectiveness of medicinal materials, the best way is to refine them into elixirs. Therefore, Chu Lingtian planned to become an alchemist.
Although "Alchemist Basics" is only an introductory manual, it is extremely difficult to practice. But fortunately, Chu Lingtian owns the Chaos Pagoda, and the most important thing is time.
After putting the things into the first floor of the pagoda, Chu Lingtian left the trading center city, left the city as quickly as possible, and entered the Fengyun Mountains outside the city.
Fengyun Mountain Range is a monster mountain range. The mountains are rich in spiritual energy and there are many monsters living there. There are even powerful second-level high-level monsters among them.
Monsters, like monks, also have strengths and weaknesses.
In the Kyushu Continent, monsters are divided into nine realms. From low to high, they are first-order monsters, second-order monsters, third-order monsters... and ninth-order monsters.
Each level of monster is subdivided into three levels: low-level, intermediate, and high-level.
A first-level low-level monster, with strength equivalent to that of a monk from the first to the third heaven of spiritual beings. A first-level intermediate monster has a strength equivalent to that of a monk from the fourth to sixth heaven of the spiritual realm, and so on...
The strength of the second-level high-level monsters is equivalent to that of spiritual masters from the seventh to ninth heavens.
Fengyun City was named Fengyun City because it was close to Fengyun Mountain Range.
The reason why Chu Lingtian left the Chu family and entered the Fengyun Mountains. One is because after taking care of Chu Yun, Chu Shan will definitely guess that he can practice again and will secretly kill him.
The second reason is that the Fengyun Mountains are rich in aura of heaven and earth. In addition to being home to many monsters, there are also many precious medicinal materials growing there.
Chu Lingtian does not need to find mature first-grade medicinal materials. He only needs to find the seeds of first-grade medicinal materials or immature first-grade medicinal materials and plant them into the first layer of the pagoda.
In this way, the difficulty of finding medicinal materials will be greatly reduced.
Just as Chu Lingtian expected, just when he entered the Fengyun Mountains, the head of the family, Chu Shan, brought several elders to Chu Lingtian's other courtyard in a menacing manner.
"Chu Lingtian, you committed an unprovoked attack and seriously injured a clan member, why don't you come out and take the blame!" Chu Shan said coldly.
Chu Yun's father, the third elder Chu Jiang, rushed into the house and wanted to kill Chu Lingtian and avenge Chu Yun, but found that Chu Lingtian was not in the house at all.
"Chu Lingtian ran away!" Chu Jiang said with overwhelming hatred.
When Chu Shan heard this, a cold light flashed in his eyes, and he immediately ordered the Chu family members to search for Chu Lingtian throughout the city.
An hour later, the elder who led the search team returned to the Chu family to report.
"Master, according to the clues, Chu Lingtian has entered Fengyun Mountain Range." Upon hearing this, Chu Shan narrowed his eyes slightly and felt uneasy in his heart.
"We should have been relentless in our efforts to kill Chu Lingtian right after he pulled away the Ling Yan bloodline. Although he would suffer infamy, it would be better than laying the foundation for disaster." Chu Shan said regretfully in his heart.
Seeing the worry on Chu Shan's face, Chu Haochen said: "Don't worry, father. As long as Chu Lingtian wants to enter the academy, he will definitely show up in eight days and have a life-or-death duel with me. At that time, I will kill him with my own hands."
According to Chu Yun's description, even if Chu Lingtian's damaged foundation was restored, his cultivation would only reach the sixth level of the Spiritual Realm.
And his cultivation level has reached the ninth level of the spiritual realm. It is three small realms higher than Chu Lingtian.
And, more importantly, when Chushan dedicated his Lingyan bloodline to his master, the master gave him a lot of rewards.
Among them, there is the elixir "Lingwu Dan" for improving one's cultivation.
Lingwu Dan is a second-grade mid-level elixir, and its efficacy is several times more powerful than Qi Yun Dan!
With the help of Lingwu Dan, Chu Haochen is confident that he can break through to the first level of spiritual master within half a month, or even higher!
